_comment: Structured store for highest-stakes CMU-Q facts (deadlines, amounts, GPA cutoffs, credit limits). To add an entry: copy the object shape below (omit _comment), pick a stable camelCase id, write a short searchable topic phrase (used by checkKeyFacts keyword matching), set value to the exact approved wording, lastVerified to ISO date when you confirmed it, and source to a human-readable label (not a file path). Restart the server after editing.

topic: tafawq merit scholarship gpa requirement
value: TAFAWQ merit scholarship requires a cumulative GPA of 4.0.

topic: tamaiyuz scholarship gpa requirement
value: TAMAIYUZ scholarship requires a cumulative GPA of 3.8 or higher.

topic: tafawq scholarship application fee
value: TAFAWQ scholarship application fee is QAR 183 (50 USD), paid upon application submission.

topic: tamaiyuz scholarship application deadline dates
value: TAMAIYUZ scholarship application cycle is open from 15 May 2026 until 5 June 2026.

topic: course overload unit limit credits
value: Students may register for a course overload of up to 12 units with academic advisor approval. Overloads above 12 units require advisor approval and an S3 maximum-units adjustment (available no earlier than the Saturday after Registration Week).

topic: cross registration fall 2026 deadline
value: Fall 2026 Education City cross-registration forms are accepted starting July 1, 2026. The submission deadline is August 1, 2026.

topic: cross registration course limit
value: CMU-Q students may cross-register for one course per semester at another Education City university.

topic: add drop period deadline end of add period
value: For hosted students cross-registering at CMU-Q, the add period ends on the 10th day of class.

topic: id card replacement fee lost card
value: A $30 replacement fee applies for all lost CMU ID cards.

topic: fire safety penalty fee housing
value: Residents incur a penalty fee of $200 for violating fire-safety guidelines.

topic: plaid cash maximum deposit amount
value: Plaid Cash has a maximum deposit amount of $2,000.

topic: plaid cash refund processing fee
value: A processing fee of $25 is assessed for Plaid Cash refunds.

topic: minor declaration deadline registration week
value: Minor declaration forms should be submitted at least two weeks prior to registration week to be considered for available spaces in non-major courses. Students are encouraged to declare no later than the end of sophomore year.

topic: qf student housing residence hall fee cost per semester
value: QF residence hall room costs QAR 10,100 per semester (or QAR 646 per week for Winter/Summer terms).

topic: qf housing damage deposit upfront payment
value: QF student housing requires a QAR 2,000 upfront damage deposit regardless of financial aid; it is refunded at the end of stay.

topic: campus wifi network names cmuq-secure eduroam guest connect
value: CMU-Q Wi-Fi networks: CMUQ-SECURE (Andrew ID, preferred for affiliates), eduroam (visiting institution affiliates using AndrewID@andrew.cmu.edu), and CMUQ-GUEST (visitors; SMS PIN authentication, expires within 24 hours).
source: Connect to WiFi page (myCMU-Q Computing Services)

topic: vpn setup address qatar pittsburgh anyconnect
value: CMU VPN addresses: vpn.qatar.cmu.edu (CMU-Q campus VPN) and vpn.cmu.edu (Pittsburgh campus VPN). Use Cisco AnyConnect on all platforms.

topic: campus printing papercut portal print release hours delete
value: Campus printing uses PaperCut MF. Print and release jobs at print.qatar.cmu.edu or by swiping your CMU ID at the printer. Unreleased print jobs are auto-deleted after 8 hours.

topic: computing services help center email phone contact support
value: Computing Services Help Center: helpcenter@qatar.cmu.edu or phone 4454-8440.

topic: university honors gpa qpa requirement semesters
value: University Honors is awarded to students with a cumulative QPA of at least 3.5 after seven semesters of full-time enrollment.

topic: qf need based grant financial aid application fas portal
value: QF Need-Based Grant (for students entering Aug 2019+) is applied for via fas.qf.org.qa. CMU-Q admission is need-blind.

topic: caps-q counseling services free confidential appointments
value: CaPS-Q provides free, confidential mental health support to all CMU-Q students including individual therapy, crisis intervention, and walk-in sessions for urgent needs.
